verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל־ יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh bə·‘ar·ḇōṯ mō·w·’āḇ ‘al- yar·dên yə·rê·ḥōw lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho . . .

verses.original: צַו֮ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְנָתְנ֣וּ מִֽנַּחֲלַ֛ת אֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם עָרִ֣ים לַלְוִיִּ֗ם לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרָ֗שׁ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַלְוִיִּֽם׃ לֶֽעָרִים֙
verses.transliteration: ṣaw ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·nā·ṯə·nū min·na·ḥă·laṯ ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯām ‘ā·rîm lal·wî·yim lā·šā·ḇeṯ ū·miḡ·rāš sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯê·hem tit·tə·nū lal·wî·yim le·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: Command - the Israelites . . . to give from the inheritance they will possess cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around . . . . . . the cities

verses.original: הֶֽעָרִ֛ים וְהָי֧וּ לָהֶ֖ם לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֗ם יִהְי֤וּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם֙ וְלִרְכֻשָׁ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל חַיָּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: he·‘ā·rîm wə·hā·yū lā·hem lā·šā·ḇeṯ ū·miḡ·rə·šê·hem yih·yū liḇ·hem·tām wə·lir·ḵu·šām ū·lə·ḵōl ḥay·yā·ṯām
verses.literal: The cities will be for them to live in and the pasturelands will be for their herds their flocks and all their other livestock

verses.original: וּמִגְרְשֵׁי֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַלְוִיִּ֑ם הָעִיר֙ וָח֔וּצָה אֶ֥לֶף אַמָּ֖ה מִקִּ֤יר סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miḡ·rə·šê he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū lal·wî·yim hā·‘îr wā·ḥū·ṣāh ’e·lep̄ ’am·māh miq·qîr sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: The pasturelands around the cities - you are to give the Levites - [will extend] a thousand cubits from the wall on every side

verses.original: וּמַדֹּתֶ֞ם אַלְפַּ֪יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֟ה וְאֶת־ מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֗יר אֶת־ קֵ֣דְמָה פְּאַת־ אַלְפַּ֨יִם בָּאַמָּ֜ה וְאֶת־ נֶגֶב֩ פְּאַת־ אַלְפַּ֣יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֗ה וְאֵ֨ת יָ֣ם׀ פְּאַת־ אַלְפַּ֥יִם בָּאַמָּ֖ה צָפ֛וֹן פְּאַ֥ת וְהָעִ֣יר בַּתָּ֑וֶךְ זֶ֚ה יִהְיֶ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם מִגְרְשֵׁ֖י הֶעָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mad·dō·ṯem ’al·pa·yim bā·’am·māh wə·’eṯ- mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr ’eṯ- qê·ḏə·māh pə·’aṯ- ’al·pa·yim bā·’am·māh wə·’eṯ- ne·ḡeḇ pə·’aṯ- ’al·pa·yim bā·’am·māh wə·’êṯ yām pə·’aṯ- ’al·pa·yim bā·’am·māh ṣā·p̄ō·wn pə·’aṯ wə·hā·‘îr bat·tā·weḵ zeh yih·yeh lā·hem miḡ·rə·šê he·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: You are also to measure two thousand cubits - outside the city - on the east - two thousand - on the south - two thousand - on the west - [and] two thousand - on the north - with the city in the center These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת שֵׁשׁ־ הֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתְּנ֔וּ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט הָרֹצֵ֑חַ לָנֻ֥ס שָׁ֖מָּה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם תִּתְּנ֔וּ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם עִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ šêš- he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū lal·wî·yim ’êṯ ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū ‘ā·rê ham·miq·lāṭ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ lā·nus šām·māh wa·‘ă·lê·hem tit·tə·nū ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·ta·yim ‘îr
verses.literal: - Six of the cities - you give the Levites - - are to be appointed as cities of refuge to which a manslayer may flee - In addition to these give [the Levites] forty-two . . . other cities

verses.original: כָּל־ הֶעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה עִ֑יר אֶתְהֶ֖ן וְאֶת־ מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū lal·wî·yim ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·mō·neh ‘îr ’eṯ·hen wə·’eṯ- miḡ·rə·šê·hen
verses.literal: The total number of cities - you give the Levites [will be] forty-eight . . . . . . with their corresponding - pasturelands

verses.original: וְהֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵאֵ֤ת מֵאֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִתֵּ֥ן מֵעָרָ֖יו לַלְוִיִּֽם׃פ כְּפִ֤י נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִנְחָ֔לוּ אִ֗ישׁ וּמֵאֵ֥ת תַּרְבּ֔וּ הָרַב֙ תַּמְעִ֑יטוּ הַמְעַ֖ט
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū mê·’êṯ mê·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl yit·tên mê·‘ā·rāw lal·wî·yim kə·p̄î na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw ’ă·šer yin·ḥā·lū ’îš ū·mê·’êṯ tar·bū hā·raḇ tam·‘î·ṭū ham·‘aṭ
verses.literal: The cities that you apportion . . . from the territory vvv of the Israelites should be given - to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance - - of each [tribe] . . . more from a larger [tribe] and less from a smaller one

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kî ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên ’ar·ṣāh kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them . . . When you cross - the Jordan into the land of Canaan

verses.original: וְהִקְרִיתֶ֤ם לָכֶם֙ עָרִ֔ים תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לָכֶ֑ם עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט רֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃ וְנָ֥ס שָׁ֙מָּה֙
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rî·ṯem lā·ḵem ‘ā·rîm tih·ye·nāh lā·ḵem ‘ā·rê miq·lāṭ rō·ṣê·aḥ mak·kêh- ne·p̄eš biš·ḡā·ḡāh wə·nās šām·māh
verses.literal: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֧ם הֶעָרִ֛ים לְמִקְלָ֖ט מִגֹּאֵ֑ל הָרֹצֵ֔חַ וְלֹ֤א יָמוּת֙ עַד־ עָמְד֛וֹ לַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū lā·ḵem he·‘ā·rîm lə·miq·lāṭ mig·gō·’êl hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ wə·lō yā·mūṯ ‘aḏ- ‘ā·mə·ḏōw lam·miš·pāṭ lip̄·nê hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֵּ֑נוּ תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לָכֶֽם׃ שֵׁשׁ־ עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer tit·tê·nū tih·ye·nāh lā·ḵem šêš- ‘ā·rê miq·lāṭ
verses.literal: The cities - you select will be your six cities of refuge

verses.original: אֵ֣ת׀ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶעָרִ֗ים תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵעֵ֣בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְאֵת֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים תִּתְּנ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן תִּהְיֶֽינָה׃ עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ šə·lōš he·‘ā·rîm tit·tə·nū mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên wə·’êṯ šə·lōš he·‘ā·rîm tit·tə·nū bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an tih·ye·nāh ‘ā·rê miq·lāṭ
verses.literal: - Select three cities . . . across the Jordan - and three - - in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge

verses.original: הָאֵ֖לֶּה שֵׁשׁ־ הֶעָרִ֥ים תִּהְיֶ֛ינָה לְמִקְלָ֑ט לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּ֤ר וְלַתּוֹשָׁב֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔ם כָּל־ מַכֵּה־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃ לָנ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּה
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl·leh šêš- he·‘ā·rîm tih·ye·nāh lə·miq·lāṭ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lag·gêr wə·lat·tō·wō·šāḇ bə·ṯō·w·ḵām kāl- mak·kêh- ne·p̄eš biš·ḡā·ḡāh lā·nūs šām·māh
verses.literal: These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites . . . and for the foreigner or stranger among them so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there

verses.original: וְאִם־ הִכָּ֛הוּ בַרְזֶ֧ל׀ בִּכְלִ֨י וַיָּמֹ֖ת ה֑וּא רֹצֵ֣חַֽ הָרֹצֵֽחַ׃ מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- hik·kā·hū ḇar·zel biḵ·lî way·yā·mōṯ hū rō·ṣê·aḥ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ mō·wṯ yū·maṯ
verses.literal: If, however anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him he is a murderer the murderer must surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: וְאִ֡ם יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר־ בְּאֶ֣בֶן יָמ֨וּת בָּ֥הּ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ הָרֹצֵֽחַ׃ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת
verses.transliteration: wə·’im yāḏ ’ă·šer- bə·’e·ḇen yā·mūṯ bāh hik·kā·hū way·yā·mōṯ rō·ṣê·aḥ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ hū mō·wṯ yū·maṯ
verses.literal: Or if anyone has in his hand - a stone of deadly size and he strikes and kills another he is a murderer the murderer - must surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: א֡וֹ יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יָמ֨וּת בִּכְלִ֣י עֵֽץ־ בּ֥וֹ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ הָרֹצֵֽחַ׃ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת
verses.transliteration: ’ōw yāḏ ’ă·šer- yā·mūṯ biḵ·lî ‘êṣ- bōw hik·kā·hū way·yā·mōṯ rō·ṣê·aḥ hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ hū mō·wṯ yū·maṯ
verses.literal: If anyone has in his hand - a deadly object of wood and he strikes and kills another he is a murderer the murderer . . . must surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם ה֥וּא אֶת־ הָרֹצֵ֑חַ יָמִ֖ית בְּפִגְעוֹ־ ב֖וֹ ה֥וּא יְמִיתֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: gō·’êl had·dām hū ’eṯ- hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ yā·mîṯ bə·p̄iḡ·‘ōw- ḇōw hū yə·mî·ṯen·nū
verses.literal: The avenger of blood - - {is to put} the murderer to death when he finds him he is to kill him

verses.original: וְאִם־ בְּשִׂנְאָ֖ה יֶהְדָּפֶ֑נּוּ אֽוֹ־ בִּצְדִיָּ֖ה הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛יו וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bə·śin·’āh yeh·dā·p̄en·nū ’ōw- biṣ·ḏî·yāh hiš·lîḵ ‘ā·lāw way·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him

verses.original: א֣וֹ בְאֵיבָ֞ה הִכָּ֤הוּ בְיָדוֹ֙ וַיָּמֹ֔ת הַמַּכֶּ֖ה מֽוֹת־ יוּמַ֥ת ה֑וּא רֹצֵ֣חַֽ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֗ם בְּפִגְעוֹ־ הָרֹצֵ֖חַ בֽוֹ׃ יָמִ֛ית אֶת־
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ḇə·’ê·ḇāh hik·kā·hū ḇə·yā·ḏōw way·yā·mōṯ ham·mak·keh mō·wṯ- yū·maṯ hū rō·ṣê·aḥ gō·’êl had·dām bə·p̄iḡ·‘ōw- hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ḇōw yā·mîṯ ’eṯ-
verses.literal: or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies the one who struck him must surely be put to death . . . he is a murderer When the avenger of blood finds the murderer he is to kill him

verses.original: וְאִם־ הֲדָפ֑וֹ בְּפֶ֥תַע בְּלֹא־ אֵיבָ֖ה אוֹ־ הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ כָּל־ כְּלִ֖י עָלָ֛יו בְּלֹ֥א צְדִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- hă·ḏā·p̄ōw bə·p̄e·ṯa‘ bə·lō- ’ê·ḇāh ’ōw- hiš·lîḵ kāl- kə·lî ‘ā·lāw bə·lō ṣə·ḏî·yāh
verses.literal: But if anyone pushes a person suddenly without hostility or throws an object at him unintentionally . . .

verses.original: א֣וֹ בְכָל־ בְּלֹ֣א רְא֔וֹת וַיַּפֵּ֥ל עָלָ֖יו אֶ֜בֶן אֲשֶׁר־ יָמ֥וּת בָּהּ֙ וַיָּמֹ֑ת וְהוּא֙ לֹא־ אוֹיֵ֣ב ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ רָעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ḇə·ḵāl- bə·lō rə·’ō·wṯ way·yap·pêl ‘ā·lāw ’e·ḇen ’ă·šer- yā·mūṯ bāh way·yā·mōṯ wə·hū lō- ’ō·w·yêḇ lōw wə·lō mə·ḇaq·qêš rā·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: or . . . without looking drops . . . a heavy stone that kills him but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him

verses.original: הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וְשָֽׁפְטוּ֙ בֵּ֚ין הַמַּכֶּ֔ה וּבֵ֖ין גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֑ם עַ֥ל הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ê·ḏāh wə·šā·p̄ə·ṭū bên ham·mak·keh ū·ḇên gō·’êl had·dām ‘al hā·’êl·leh ham·miš·pā·ṭîm
verses.literal: then the congregation must judge between the slayer . . . and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances

verses.original: הָעֵדָ֜ה אֶת־ וְהִצִּ֨ילוּ הָרֹצֵ֗חַ מִיַּד֮ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּם֒ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וְהֵשִׁ֤יבוּ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶל־ עִ֥יר מִקְלָט֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ נָ֣ס שָׁ֑מָּה וְיָ֣שַׁב בָּ֗הּ עַד־ מוֹת֙ הַגָּדֹ֔ל הַכֹּהֵ֣ן אֲשֶׁר־ מָשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’eṯ- wə·hiṣ·ṣî·lū hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ mî·yaḏ gō·’êl had·dām hā·‘ê·ḏāh wə·hê·šî·ḇū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- ‘îr miq·lā·ṭōw ’ă·šer- nās šām·māh wə·yā·šaḇ bāh ‘aḏ- mō·wṯ hag·gā·ḏōl hak·kō·hên ’ă·šer- mā·šaḥ ’ō·ṯōw haq·qō·ḏeš bə·še·men
verses.literal: The assembly - is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled . . . and he must live there until the death of the high priest who was anointed - with the holy oil

verses.original: וְאִם־ הָרֹצֵ֑חַ אֶת־ יָצֹ֥א יֵצֵ֖א גְּבוּל֙ עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנ֖וּס שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ’eṯ- yā·ṣō yê·ṣê gə·ḇūl ‘îr miq·lā·ṭōw ’ă·šer yā·nūs šām·māh
verses.literal: But if the manslayer - ever goes outside . . . the limits of the city of refuge - to which he fled . . .

verses.original: גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם וּמָצָ֤א אֹתוֹ֙ מִח֕וּץ לִגְב֖וּל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑וֹ וְרָצַ֞ח גֹּאֵ֤ל אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּֽם׃ הַדָּם֙ אֶת־ הָ֣רֹצֵ֔חַ
verses.transliteration: gō·’êl had·dām ū·mā·ṣā ’ō·ṯōw mi·ḥūṣ liḡ·ḇūl ‘îr miq·lā·ṭōw wə·rā·ṣaḥ gō·’êl ’ên lōw dām had·dām ’eṯ- hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ
verses.literal: and the avenger of blood finds him outside . . . of his city of refuge and kills him [then] the avenger will not - be guilty of bloodshed - -

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֵשֵׁ֔ב בְעִ֤יר מִקְלָטוֹ֙ עַד־ מ֖וֹת הַגָּדֹ֑ל הַכֹּהֵ֣ן וְאַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹת֙ הַגָּדֹ֔ל הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הָרֹצֵ֔חַ יָשׁוּב֙ אֶל־ אֶ֖רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yê·šêḇ ḇə·‘îr miq·lā·ṭōw ‘aḏ- mō·wṯ hag·gā·ḏōl hak·kō·hên wə·’a·ḥă·rê mō·wṯ hag·gā·ḏōl hak·kō·hên hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ yā·šūḇ ’el- ’e·reṣ ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯōw
verses.literal: because [the manslayer] must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest Only after the death of the high priest may [he] return to the land he owns

verses.original: אֵ֧לֶּה וְהָי֨וּ לְחֻקַּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּ֖ט לָכֶ֛ם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh wə·hā·yū lə·ḥuq·qaṯ miš·pāṭ lā·ḵem lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵōl mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come wherever you live

verses.original: כָּל־ מַ֨כֵּה־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ יִרְצַ֖ח אֶת־ הָרֹצֵ֑חַ לְפִ֣י עֵדִ֔ים לֹא־ בְנֶ֖פֶשׁ לָמֽוּת׃ יַעֲנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֔ד וְעֵ֣ד
verses.transliteration: kāl- mak·kêh- ne·p̄eš yir·ṣaḥ ’eṯ- hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ lə·p̄î ‘ê·ḏîm lō- ḇə·ne·p̄eš lā·mūṯ ya·‘ă·neh ’e·ḥāḏ wə·‘êḏ
verses.literal: If anyone kills a person the murderer - is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תִקְח֥וּ כֹ֙פֶר֙ לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ רֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר־ ה֥וּא רָשָׁ֖ע לָמ֑וּת כִּי־ מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯiq·ḥū ḵō·p̄er lə·ne·p̄eš rō·ṣê·aḥ ’ă·šer- hū rā·šā‘ lā·mūṯ kî- mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who . . . deserves to die . . . he must surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: וְלֹא־ תִקְח֣וּ כֹ֔פֶר לָנ֖וּס אֶל־ עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑וֹ לָשׁוּב֙ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת בָּאָ֔רֶץ עַד־ מ֖וֹת הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯiq·ḥū ḵō·p̄er lā·nūs ’el- ‘îr miq·lā·ṭōw lā·šūḇ lā·še·ḇeṯ bā·’ā·reṣ ‘aḏ- mō·wṯ hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תַחֲנִ֣יפוּ אֶת־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בָּ֔הּ כִּ֣י הַדָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יַחֲנִ֖יף אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא־ יְכֻפַּ֗ר וְלָאָ֣רֶץ לַדָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שֻׁפַּךְ־ בָּ֔הּ כִּי־ אִ֖ם בְּדַ֥ם שֹׁפְכֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯa·ḥă·nî·p̄ū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tem bāh kî had·dām hū ya·ḥă·nîp̄ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ lō- yə·ḵup·par wə·lā·’ā·reṣ lad·dām ’ă·šer šup·paḵ- bāh kî- ’im bə·ḏam šō·p̄ə·ḵōw
verses.literal: Do not pollute - the land where you live for bloodshed . . . pollutes - the land and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood - is shed except . . . by the blood of the one who shed it

verses.original: וְלֹ֧א תְטַמֵּ֣א הָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ן בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁכֵ֕ן בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṯə·ṭam·mê hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- ’ă·šer ’at·tem yō·šə·ḇîm bāh ’ă·šer ’ă·nî šō·ḵên bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh šō·ḵên bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Do not defile the land - where you live and where I dwell For I the LORD dwell among the Israelites . . .
